task.title: Readable names in reports
task.goal: Rename the short names in every module of reports/ (val → value, lim → limit, rs → rows), parameters included: every caller passes them by position, so their keyword names are not an interface to keep. Pure renaming: no behaviour change.

report:
Renamed val → value, lim → limit and rs → rows in all 40 report modules.
Mechanical change, no behaviour change.
